G1_unambiguity.justification: The assignment variables, validity condition, tree structure, and objective are all defined clearly enough to permit only one reasonable interpretation.

G2_completeness.justification: It includes the necessary bounds, input meanings, tree guarantees, cost definition, output requirement, and relevant edge cases such as a single essential endpoint.

G3_faithfulness.justification: The rewritten formulation is exactly equivalent to selecting a minimum-cost set of tree edges connecting all required sites, with the same inputs, constraints, and output.

G4_naturalness.justification: The statement is coherent and readable, but its formal assignment terminology and discussion of the $2^m$ search space feel somewhat contrived for this graph problem.
